job: Edit a value, see what the change will touch, then commit it with a reason.
purpose: A pattern for changes whose reach depends on what is typed. The edit fields come first with a Preview button; asking for a preview checks them, fires fd:open (fill the fd-impact then) and shows the result: the impact and an fd-commit. Changing a field afterwards marks the preview stale, hides the commit and says to preview again. It works inline or inside a dialog.
useWhen: Changing a default, a limit or a policy that applies to many teams at once.
The person should see "412 teams change" before the commit button exists.

avoidWhen.when: Nothing is edited and the reach is known: show it in the case.
A setting that affects only the person changing it.

states.name: editing
states.how: no data-state: the edit fields and the Preview button

states.name: stale
states.how: data-state="stale": a field changed after the preview; fd-preview-stale shows

variants.useWhen: On the button that asks for the preview.

parts.role: The form that holds the edit and the result.
The fields and the Preview button.
The line that says the preview is out of date.

keyboard.does: In an edit field: asks for the preview; it never commits.
